canonical_project: Wanjie Xinjiang Jiangsuan 10,000-card hub AI computing center
owner: Urumqi Jiangsuan Technology Development Co., Ltd. / Beijing Wanjie Data Technology
notes: Xinjiang government reported Beijing Wanjie began construction in September 2025 in the Lianghe area of Urumqi Economic and Technological Development Zone/Toutunhe; phase 1 plans 10000P by October 2026 and phase 2 targets 20000P by 2027, using an integrated compute, renewable power and virtual power plant model with a self-built 220 kV substation.
